name: choice-list
title: Choice list
description: One list for choosing one or several: label, description, media and a trailing value on every row, divided by hairlines, with an exclusive None row.
docs: mode='single' (the default) makes the rows radios and mode='multiple' makes them checkboxes; value and onValueChange are controlled or uncontrolled. Every row is a real control, so with a name a form submits name=value natively. Mark an option exclusive for 'None of these': choosing it clears the others and choosing any other clears it. media takes an icon or an avatar, trailing a price or a count, and a disabled option can say why in its description. A row without media keeps the room for it, so the labels stay in one line. A chosen row shows the control, a heavier label and a tint, never colour alone, and the count of picks is announced in multiple mode.
